title: 第2103章 至尊法则退神魔白僧托付佛经舍利第2102章 三头六眼修罗神魔
content_zh:
顾余生站于摆渡船头，魂身挺拔，金色的光护着神魂，当他的目光看向那一尊三头六眼的神像时，出乎意料的一幕出现了：那一尊神像脚下泛起浓郁的荒气，荒气向上弥漫时，荒符逆旋上升，在神像中间的头颅上凝出一只独特的眼睛，眼睛睁开的刹那，一束幽光袭照在顾余生身上，并扇散向身后，试图将摆渡船上的那些灵魂一起罩进去。
但顾余生身上的金光流转，竟生生将整座摆渡船一起护了进去，他目光里的神像多出来的那一只眼和周身弥漫的荒气，竟与当年两盟豢养在天穹上的荒兽一模一样。
只不过，彼时强大的荒兽，在这尊神像面前，温顺无比，就好像原本只是他饲养的一只灵宠。
几乎一瞬间，顾余生便已想通过去无法解开的谜底：“原来如此，你才是掌控永夜和吞噬灵魂的祸首。”
“区区一只蝼蚁，不仅有一双洞察世事的眼睛，还拥有天大的胆子，竟敢违背大魂主的契约，不渡灵魂，这样也好，这些我无法吞噬炼化的灵魂，将会借助你的力量为我所用。”
修罗神魔说话间，身上的三个头从躯体分离，化作三尊魔影站成品字形，将顾余生困于中间，三尊修罗从嘴里吐出不同颜色的神光，击打在顾余生灵魂神光上，每一道神光之中包裹着魂链分别拉扯着顾余生的天魂，地魂，人魂。
顾余生立于摆渡船上，魂躯无动，但已有儒道佛三种不同的力量化作神光庇护着每一道灵魂，他的双眸神光交汇处，三把本命剑以灵魂的形式从本命瓶内飞出，狠狠斩向那三根魂链。
铮铮铮！
三声脆响，剑星四溅，以三剑之力，前番足已斩断困住蓝灵姬的狐族魂链，却无法斩断眼前的魂链，足见这位神秘的修罗神魔实力有多恐怖。
一剑未斩断，顾余生立时觉察到自己的灵魂力量正被魂链汲取，正向外泄流，他心神剧震，尤其是他的天魂，因为曾被夺取，虽然如今已归体，但终究弱一些，灵魂如粒子般附着在魂链上，正向修罗神魔的嘴流去。
这时，顾余生身后传来阵阵梵梵之音，却是那些白衣僧修的灵魂，正默默诵读佛宗经文，将这一份慈悲的力量加持在他灵魂躯体上，使得他灵魂获得一时的自由和支配。
顾余生见状，当即大喝一声，他将自身目前所能领悟的时间法则附着于木剑，空间法则附着于地魂剑，那一缕微弱的轮回气息附着于人魂剑，三把剑于空中交汇，凝成一把：“斩！”
三剑合一的剑气被他强大的神识操控凭空斩下，只听得噌的一声脆响，三根魂链被轻易斩断，三种时间法则的力量融入剑气，朝着断裂的魂链弥漫，在顾余生准备斩出第二剑时，三道惨叫声同时发出，三尊修罗神像如同叠影融合在一起，他的躯体里不断溢出荒气，试图抵挡这一股力量，而更多的灵魂，从他的六只眼睛里飞出来。
凄厉挣扎的声音震得顾余生灵魂飘摇，修罗神魔的躯体陡然化作万丈之巨，临江之水断流，江河之水被他一口吞入腹中，无数生存在临江的妖兽被他完全吞噬。
大地裂开一道口子，他的躯体好像与大地融合在一起，不断下沉，中间的那一只独眼凝看着顾余生，愤怒的声音在回响：“人族蝼蚁，竟敢染指支配三大至尊法则，终有一天将为我所有……”
修罗神魔的气息消失在大地，但整个大荒的迷雾更加浓郁，顾余生以灵魂之身，好似快要在这个现实与虚幻的世界里失去方向，一点点沉沦，想要昏昏欲睡。
“阿弥陀佛。”身后传来魂僧的声音，“施主骨少魂强，集三教于一身，承蒙渡化一程，贫僧祝施主他日问道有成。”
顾余生回头，发现刚刚还满乘一船的魂僧一个个坐化，将最后的力量集中于一名僧人身上，使其恢复记忆，而其余僧人，被其合于双掌之间，凝成一颗琉璃色的舍利子。
“贫僧执悟，乃梵天寺守经人，量劫之时，领一众僧修转运佛经，途遇古魔袭击，只得将灵魂寄藏于经卷之中得以存续，这枚琉璃舍利，内藏佛宗所有经卷，祈盼施主将其传于佛门子弟，此间功德，必承佑施主。”
顾余生没有接过舍利子，问道：“我观大师气息与如今大梵天，大乘寺僧略有不同，实不相瞒，我与如今的大梵天圣地，有不少因果私仇在其中，恐难如大师心愿。”

“施主，佛即是佛，道即是道，前人不改，后人不易，大道如山，行者何路，非人力所为，施主自觉是对的，便是对的，终有一天，施主会见到真正的佛门弟子，请勿推辞。”
“好。”
顾余生没有再推辞，接过那一枚琉璃色的舍利子，将其封印在一个禅盒里。
船上的僧人执念已了，灵魂消散在天地之间。
顾余生一人渡船，穿过层层迷雾，最终回到天妖城，睁开眼时，蓝灵姬正专心为他护法，并未动任何手脚。
“顾余生，这下你我恩怨两清了吧？”蓝灵姬一脸苍白，她旧伤未愈，一番激斗后又被狐族三老袭击，早已处于空耗状态。
“休整一下吧，尽快将天妖城的秩序稳定下来，最多一天我会亲赴万妖城，最后一探大荒以西的沙漠。”
顾余生说完，纵身一跃，消失在原地，再出现时，已在天妖城的一座酒楼下，酒楼之上，写着忘仙居三个字，他储物袋里的一块令牌微微明亮，正是曾经拜月阁给他的那一枚贵宾令。
“原来是十五先生到了，请上楼。”
出来迎接顾余生的，是一位富态的中年男子，当年把酒楼开在芦城的神秘上人金算盘，忘仙居酒楼，生意几乎开遍所有太乙，顾余生在时沙之地见过，只是没想到当自己兜兜转转至天妖城时，又与这位扮作商人的修士相见。
“金道友，世界真小呢。”
“世事多有巧合，能再与十五先生相遇，是在下的福分。”有着金算盘称号的男子引顾余生上楼，入座时，桌子上已摆满了好菜，仿佛早就预料到顾余生会来一般。
“听闻十五先生爱酒，在下差人在临江之畔建了个酒肆，至今日刚好酿了三坛，此酒尚未取名，请十五先生先品鉴一二。”
清澈浓香的酒牵成一线落进酒碗，溅起一层酒花，不似以往的酒那般混浊，其味之厚，宛若北凉烧刀子，顾余生一路西来，未有懈怠，刚刚历经一场生死，如今酒在身前，自不推辞，端起来一口畅饮，辛辣之味入喉，又好似一团火在隆冬时节熊熊燃烧，不由地赞道：“痛快！！果真是好酒，我闻神仙难饮临江水，我今儿也当一回仙人了。
一旁站着伺候的金算盘眯笑着恭维：“经十五先生一品，此酒便唤作【临江仙】吧！”
“临江仙？倒是有趣的酒名，”顾余生放下酒盏，意味深长：“月前向人族发出求救信符的之人，是金道友吗？”
content_en:
Gu Yusheng stood at the bow of the ferry boat, his soul body upright, and the golden light protected his soul. When he looked at the statue with three heads and six eyes, an unexpected scene appeared: a strong desolate atmosphere appeared at the feet of the statue, and the desolate atmosphere spread upward. Over time, the desolate talisman rose in counter-rotation, condensing a unique eye on the head in the middle of the statue. The moment the eye opened, a beam of light shone on Gu Yusheng and spread behind him, trying to cover the souls on the ferry boat.
But the golden light flowing around Gu Yusheng's body actually protected the entire ferry boat. The extra eye of the statue in his eyes and the desolate aura surrounding him were exactly the same as the desolate beasts raised by the two alliances in the sky.
However, the powerful wild beast at that time was extremely docile in front of this statue, as if it was just a spiritual pet he raised.
Almost instantly, Gu Yusheng thought about the answer to the mystery that could not be solved in the past: "So, you are the culprit who controls the eternal night and swallows souls."
"A mere ant not only has a pair of eyes that can see the world, but also has great courage. He dares to violate the contract of the great soul master and not transfer his soul. This is fine. These souls that I cannot swallow and refine will be used by me with the help of your power."
As the Shura God and Demon spoke, the three heads separated from the body and turned into three demonic shadows standing in the shape of a glyph, trapping Gu Yusheng in the middle. The three Shura gods spit out divine light of different colors from their mouths and hit the divine light of Gu Yusheng's soul. Each divine light was wrapped in a soul chain that pulled Gu Yusheng's heavenly soul, earthly soul, and human soul respectively.
Gu Yusheng stood on the ferry boat, his soul body motionless, but the three different powers of Confucianism, Taoism and Buddhism had turned into divine light to protect each soul. At the intersection of the divine light in his eyes, three natal swords flew out of the natal bottle in the form of souls, slashing hard at the three soul chains.
Zhengzhengzheng!
With three crisp sounds, the sword stars flew everywhere. With the power of the three swords, the former had already cut off the fox soul chain that trapped Lan Lingji, but was unable to cut off the soul chain in front of him. This shows how terrifying this mysterious Shura god and demon is.
Before the sword was cut, Gu Yusheng immediately realized that his soul power was being absorbed by the soul chain and leaking out. He was greatly shaken, especially his heavenly soul. Because it had been taken away, although it had returned to the body now, it was weaker after all. The soul was attached to the soul chain like particles and was flowing towards the mouths of Shura gods and demons.
At this time, bursts of Sanskrit sounds came from behind Gu Yusheng, but it was the souls of those monks in white who were silently reciting Buddhist scriptures, blessing his soul and body with this compassionate power, allowing his soul to gain temporary freedom and control.
When Gu Yusheng saw this, he immediately shouted loudly. He attached the law of time that he could understand so far to the wooden sword, the law of space to the earth soul sword, and the weak breath of reincarnation to the human soul sword. The three swords met in the air and formed one: "Cut!"
The sword energy of the three swords combined into one was cut down out of thin air by the control of his powerful spiritual consciousness. There was only a crisp sound, and the three soul chains were easily cut off. The power of the three laws of time merged into the sword energy and filled the air towards the broken soul chain. Gu Yusheng was about to cut. When the second sword was released, three screams came out at the same time, and the three Shura statues merged together like overlapping shadows. Desolate energy continued to overflow from his body, trying to resist this force, and more souls flew out from his six eyes.
The screams of struggle shook Gu Yusheng's soul. The bodies of the Shura Gods and Demons suddenly turned into giants. The water in Linjiang stopped flowing. He swallowed the water of the river into his belly. Countless monsters living in Linjiang were completely devoured by him.
A hole opened in the earth, and his body seemed to be fused with the earth, sinking continuously. The one eye in the middle stared at Gu Yusheng, and an angry voice echoed: "How dare a human ant get involved in controlling the three supreme laws, and one day he will be mine..."
The Qi of Shura Gods and DemonsThe breath disappeared on the earth, but the fog in the entire wilderness became thicker. Gu Yusheng's soul seemed to be about to lose its way in this world of reality and illusion, sinking little by little, and wanted to fall asleep.
"Amitabha." The voice of the soul monk came from behind, "The benefactor has a young bone and a strong soul. He combines the three religions in one body. Thanks to him for his transformation, the poor monk wishes the benefactor success in his quest for enlightenment in the future."
Gu Yusheng turned around and found that the soul monks who had just filled the boat were disintegrating one by one. He concentrated his last strength on one monk to restore his memory, while the other monks were put together between his palms and condensed into a glazed relic.
"The poor monk who is enlightened is the keeper of the scriptures of Brahma Temple. At the time of calamity, he led a group of monks to practice the transfer of Buddhist scriptures. They were attacked by ancient demons on the way, so they had to hide their souls in the scriptures to survive. This glass relic contains all the scriptures of the Buddhist sect. I hope that the benefactor will pass it on to the Buddhist children. The merits here will be passed down to the benefactor."
Gu Yusheng did not take the relic and asked: "I think the master's aura is slightly different from that of the current Brahma and the Mahayana monks. To be honest, I have a lot of karma and personal enmity with the current Brahma Holy Land. I may not be able to live up to the master's wish."
"Donor, the Buddha is the Buddha, and the Tao is the Tao. The predecessors will not change it, and it will not be easy for the descendants. The Tao is like a mountain, and there is no way for the traveler. It is not done by human beings. If the donor realizes that he is right, then he is right. One day, the donor will meet a true disciple of Buddhism. Please do not refuse."
"Okay."
Gu Yusheng did not refuse anymore, took the glazed relic and sealed it in a Zen box.
The monk on the boat lost his obsession, and his soul disappeared between heaven and earth.
Gu Yusheng ferried alone, passed through layers of fog, and finally returned to Tianyao City. When he opened his eyes, Lan Lingji was concentrating on protecting him and did not move any hands or feet.
"Gu Yusheng, have you and I settled our grudges now?" Lan Lingji looked pale. She had not recovered from her old injuries. After a fierce fight, she was attacked by three elders of the Fox clan, and she was already in a state of exhaustion.
"Let's take a rest and stabilize the order in Tianyao City as soon as possible. I will go to Ten Thousand Demons City in person in one day at most, and finally explore the desert west of the Great Wilderness."
After Gu Yusheng finished speaking, he jumped up and disappeared. When he reappeared, he was under a restaurant in Tianyao City. Above the restaurant, there were three words Wangxianju written on it. A token in his storage bag was slightly bright. It was the VIP token given to him by the Moon Worship Pavilion.
"It turns out Mr. Fifteen has arrived. Please come upstairs."
The person who came out to greet Gu Yusheng was a rich middle-aged man. The mysterious master Jin Abacus who opened a restaurant in Lucheng back then, Wang Xianju Restaurant, opened his business in almost all Taiyi. Gu Yusheng had seen him in Shisha Land, but he didn't expect that when he went around to Tianyao City, he would meet this monk pretending to be a businessman again.
"Fellow Daoist Jin, the world is really small."
"There are many coincidences in the world. It is my blessing to meet Mr. Fifteen again." The man with the title of Golden Abacus led Gu Yusheng upstairs. When he sat down, the table was already filled with delicious dishes, as if he had expected Gu Yusheng to come.
"I heard that Mr. Fifteen loves wine, so I sent someone to build a wine shop on the bank of the river. I have brewed three jars of it so far. This wine has not yet been named. Please give it a try, Mr. Fifteen."
The clear and fragrant wine fell into the wine bowl in a line, splashing a layer of hops. It was not as turbid as the previous wine, and its taste was as thick as a knife burned in the north. Gu Yusheng came all the way to the west without slacking off. He had just experienced a life and death, and now the wine was in front of him. , without refusing, he took a sip and took a sip. The spicy taste went into his throat, and it was like a fire burning in the middle of winter. He couldn't help but praise: "It's so good! It's really good wine. I heard that it's hard for gods to drink Linjiang water, so I became an immortal for once."
Jin Abacus, who was waiting on the side, smiled and complimented: "After Mr. Fifteen tastes it, let's call this wine [Linjiang Immortal]!" "
"Linjiang Immortal? It's an interesting wine name." Gu Yusheng put down the wine cup, meaningShen Chang: "Is the person who sent the help letter to the human race a month ago, fellow Taoist Jin?"
